title: MDEAW: A Multimodal Dataset for Emotion Analysis through EDA and PPG signals from wireless wearable low-cost off-the-shelf Devices
reasoning: The paper focuses on emotion recognition using physiological signals (EDA and PPG) in an e-learning context, classifying six basic emotions. It aims to understand how emotions affect learning outcomes. While it touches upon avoiding bias in student annotations, it does not involve evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics. A standard disclaimer is present but does not constitute a core component of ethical evaluation or benchmarking.
